text.p: Global Maintech Corp said Tuesday it completed two financing arrangements totaling $3.5 million.

Maintech said it issued non-registered common stock raising $1.5 million from a small group of investors. It also raised $2 million by issuing five-year senior notes to Mezzanine Capital Partners Inc.

The funds will be used to expand sales and marketing. The company said the cash also increases Maintech's liquidity and strengthens its balance sheet, giving it greater flexibility to expand its existing products through alliances and acquisitions of products.
The company said the cash will also help Maintech meet its goal of returning to the Nasdaq SmallCap market.
Maintech provides "Virtual Command Center" computer and software systems, used for monitoring and controlling computers in data centers.
